question: In a quadrilateral PQRS, if the sum of measures of angles ∠Q and ∠S is 150° while the measures of angles ∠P and ∠R are in ratio 4 : 3, then the measure of ∠R will be
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of all internal angles in a **quadrilateral** = 360°.

Given ∠Q + ∠S = 150°, then ∠P + ∠R = 360° − 150° = 210°.

The ratio of ∠P : ∠R = 4 : 3. Sum of ratio parts = 4 + 3 = 7 units.

7 units = 210° ⇒ 1 unit = 30°.

∴ ∠R = 3 units = 3 × 30° = 90°.

**∴ The correct answer is 90.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of angles ∠Q and ∠S = 150°

Ratio of ∠P and ∠R = 4 : 3

**Formula Used:**

Sum of interior angles of a **quadrilateral** = 360°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52ebaca184c0e5bebc6da26ff310789cd1fcb10611da0b7f7a7673a9daa9c00a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + ∠R + ∠S = 360°

⇒ (∠P + ∠R) + (∠Q + ∠S) = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠R + 150° = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠R = 360° − 150° = 210°

Let ∠P = 4x and ∠R = 3x

⇒ 4x + 3x = 210°

⇒ 7x = 210°

⇒ x = 210° ÷ 7 = 30°

⇒ ∠R = 3x = 3 × 30° = 90°

**∴ The correct answer is 90.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of interior angles of a Polygon

The sum of interior angles of any polygon with n sides is given by the formula (n − 2) × 180°.

Cyclic Quadrilateral

In a cyclic quadrilateral, the sum of opposite angles is always 180°. (∠P + ∠R = 180° and ∠Q + ∠S = 180°).

Angle Sum Property of Triangle

The sum of all three interior angles of a triangle is always 180°.</p
